Home.heroLead: Knafeh cheesecake, pistachio croissants and quiet little cakes — made by hand in Maadi, to order, for your table.
Home.heroCaption: Knafeh, pistachio, orange blossom. The pastry case at Mazzaق.
Home.featuredLead: The cakes and pastries that leave the atelier most often. Each one is finished by hand on the day it travels to you.
Home.categoriesLead: A birthday, a thank-you, a Tuesday. There is a box for each.
Home.value1Body: Nothing sits in a display case for days. Your cake starts after you order, and is finished the morning it reaches you.
Home.value2Body: Sicilian pistachio, cultured butter, Medjool dates, tahini from a Cairo mill. If we can’t name it, it doesn’t go in.
Home.value3Body: Less sugar, more flavour. Every recipe is calibrated for the Egyptian table — generous, but never heavy.
Home.ctaLead: Browse the pastry case and we’ll take it from there.

Info.shippingLead: How your order travels from our ovens to your table.
Info.shippingBody: We deliver across Cairo Tuesday to Sunday. Orders close 48 hours ahead for cakes and 24 hours ahead for pastries. Delivery is EGP 75, free over EGP 2,000. We confirm your delivery date after you order. Everything travels in a chilled box with care instructions.
Info.privacyLead: The details we keep, and why.
Info.privacyBody: We collect the name, email, phone and address needed to prepare and deliver your order. InstaPay receipts are stored only to verify transfers. We never sell your data. Order emails are sent through our email provider; in local development they are stored in the atelier outbox. You can ask us to delete your account and order history at any time by writing to hello@mazzaq.co.
Info.termsLead: The short version, in plain language.
Info.termsBody: Orders are confirmed as soon as they are placed, whether you pay cash on delivery or transfer with InstaPay. InstaPay receipts can be uploaded from your order page until delivery. Because everything is baked to order, cancellations are accepted up to 48 hours before the scheduled delivery date; after that the ingredients are already in motion. If something arrives damaged or isn’t what you ordered, contact us within two hours of delivery and we will make it right. Prices are in Egyptian pounds and include packaging; delivery is added at checkout.
Info.contactLead: For orders, press or a quiet question.
Info.contactBody: We answer messages Tuesday to Sunday, usually within a few hours.

Story.title: A Cairo atelier, built on memory.
Story.lead: Mazzaق is the Arabic word for taste — the kind that stays with you. We started in a small Maadi kitchen in 2019, baking the desserts we grew up with and finishing them with the precision we learned in pastry kitchens abroad.
Story.chapter1Body: It began with a knafeh cheesecake for a family birthday. The recipe was our grandmother’s; the technique was French. It disappeared in twenty minutes. For a year afterwards, we baked it for friends on weekends, then for their friends, until the kitchen could no longer keep up.
Story.chapter2Body: Today we work from a small atelier in Maadi with a team of eleven. We laminate our own dough, roast and grind our pistachios, and make our tahini order from a mill in old Cairo. Nothing is bought in finished. Everything is baked to order.
Story.chapter3Body: We are slowly building a menu that belongs here: Egyptian ingredients, modern technique, a lighter hand with sugar. Some things will always stay the same — the knafeh, the date cake, the handwritten notes. The rest is an ongoing conversation with our table and yours.
Story.quote: If it doesn’t taste like home, it isn’t Mazzaق.
